Louise —

Thanks for the clear list. I've drafted answers below to the three items and attached a one-pager map of our hosted data flows (redwood-hosted-data-map.pdf). High level answers:

1) Physical storage: Customer request payloads for Redwood Hosted API are persisted transiently in our serving layer located in the customer region you select (we support US regions: us-west-2 & us-east-1). Long-term storage (logs, metrics, audit trails) is stored in US-only S3 buckets for US tenants; cross-region replication is disabled for customers who opt into single-region storage. We can provide region binding in the tenant config and evidence via an exported storage policy and S3 bucket ARNs.

2) Caching: Our serving runtime uses a small in-memory KV cache for inference performance (prefix & KV cache). By default KV cache entries are ephemeral and scoped to the inference container lifecycle — typical TTLs are seconds to minutes depending on workload. For customers that require zero caching, we offer a cache-disable flag at the tenant level; for mitigated caching we can set a 0s TTL and disable prefix caching in the model route configuration.

3) Deletion timelines & evidence: For hosted API deletion requests we provide a standard process: request received -> confirm scope within 3 business days -> backend purge initiated within 5 business days -> confirmation of purge and proof-of-deletion export (S3 object deletion manifest + job run IDs) within 10 business days. For emergency erasures (legal/regulatory), we have a 48-hour escalation path. We can also produce an attestation CSV listing affected object keys and job ids.

I've included Irene (privacy lead) and Marissa (security engineering) in case you want deeper logs or a SOC-2 evidence package. If useful, I can also convert the timelines into a formal attestation doc for your records.

Regards,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive — Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Hi Louise —

Adding a few technical clarifications from privacy/engineering perspective:

• Single-region tenancy: When a tenant requests US-only residency we configure the control plane to restrict persisted artifacts (request logs, audit logs, model inputs/outputs that are retained for debug/quality) to the selected region and disable cross-region backups. We will provide the S3 bucket ARNs and IAM role ARNs used for evidence.

• KV/prefix cache persistence: The runtime is designed to garbage-collect KV caches on container shutdown; however, if the container is long-lived due to autoscaling, an entry could persist until the container is recycled. For high-sensitivity workloads we recommend enabling cache-disable and short container lifetimes (we can set pod TTLs).

• Deletion proof: Our evidence bundle includes: deletion job id, S3 deletion manifest (object keys + timestamps), audit log entries showing the orchestration step, and a signed attestation PDF. For customers requiring third-party attestation we can provide the same bundle with a notarized timestamp from our KMS.

Happy to produce a sample evidence bundle for one test request if that helps your audit.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Privacy & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference

Louise —

Quick answers and attaching a redacted sample evidence bundle (redacted_deletion_evidence.csv) in the portal. Highlights:

• Manifest format: CSV by default (columns: object_key, deleted_at_iso, object_size_bytes, sha256_hex, deletion_job_id). We also support JSON manifests on request.

• Object hashes: yes — we include SHA-256 per-object in the manifest for verification. If your pipeline needs a different digest (e.g., SHA-1) we can add it.

• Emergency erasure SLA: 48-hour initial response and 5-business-day completion for customers on our Standard support plan. For Enterprise customers (Nimbus would qualify under an enterprise contract) we provide 24-hour response and 48-hour completion with 24/7 on-call escalation. We'll include the escalation matrix in the attestation bundle.

I've uploaded a sample redacted CSV and a short escalation matrix to the secure link below (DocuSign/envelope and internal KB). If you want a live walkthrough of the evidence bundle, we can set aside 30 minutes this week.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Security Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference
